name: Capsule
summary: A brand's pop-up as a printed invitation. On chalk, the product lit in a tall dark slab takes the left of the first screen; beside it a double-ruled card holds the dates, the place, the days left and one live line on whether to go, with Book a time and Add to calendar. Then the rooms and how long a visit takes, and timed entry: a day strip and a grid of times. Bona Nova for the display, Inclusive Sans for reading; one accent from a ripe quince. For brand launches, sample sales, tasting rooms and touring installations.
